messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;
double x, y, n, mn;
long long lca(long long a, long long b){
    return a * b / (__gcd(a, b));
}
int main(){
    double x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    mn = 1e9;
    long long a, b, lc = 0;
    for(int i = 1; i <= (int)n; i++){
        long long kol = lca(y, i);
        long long ip = (x * (kol / y));
        if(ip % (kol / i) == 0){
            ip /= (kol / i);
        }
        else{
            double vok = ip;
            double pop = (kol / i);
            vok = (vok / pop) + 0.49;
            ip = vok;
        }
        double ip2 = ip;
        if(mn > abs(x / y - ip2 / (double)i)){
            mn = abs(x / y - ip2 / (double)i);
            a = ip2;
            b = i;
        }
    }
    int d = __gcd(a, b);
    a /= d;
    b /= d;
    cout << a << "/" << b;
}
